Observation: The application response headers do not include a Content-Security-Policy (CSP) header.
Potential Impact: Increases vulnerability to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), data injection, and malicious script execution.
Recommended Mitigation: Implement a restrictive CSP header specifying trusted script, style, and object sources (e.g., default-src 'self').

Potential Impact: Allows any external web origin to read cross-origin responses if ambient credentials or API tokens are leveraged.
Recommended Mitigation: Replace wildcard '*' with an explicit whitelist of trusted origins or restrict CORS on sensitive REST routes.

Observation: No 'Strict-Transport-Security' header observed on HTTP responses.
Potential Impact: Allows users or browsers to downgrade from HTTPS to unencrypted cleartext HTTP, exposing traffic to eavesdropping.
Recommended Mitigation: Deploy TLS/HTTPS and enforce 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains'.

Observation: Interactive Swagger UI and schema (/api-docs/swagger.json) are publicly accessible without authentication.
Potential Impact: Reveals the entire REST API attack surface, parameter definitions, and data models to unauthenticated actors.
Recommended Mitigation: Disable Swagger UI in production environments or restrict access using role-based authentication.

Observation: Directory index listing is enabled at /ftp, allowing browsing and downloading of arbitrary files.
Potential Impact: Information leakage of internal documents, source files, and potential path traversal / arbitrary file read vulnerabilities.
Recommended Mitigation: Disable directory listing in the web server configuration and implement strict file download access control.

Observation: Prometheus metrics endpoint exposes node.js memory usage, HTTP request counts, and internal telemetry.
Potential Impact: Provides reconnaissance intelligence about server performance, traffic patterns, and runtime environment.
Recommended Mitigation: Protect /metrics with authentication or restrict access to dedicated internal monitoring subnets.

Observation: Custom header 'X-Recruiting: /#/jobs' discloses hidden application route.
Potential Impact: Exposes unpublished application paths and internal recruitment/job endpoints to automated scanners.
Recommended Mitigation: Remove non-standard identifying headers from HTTP server responses.

Observation: Search bar accepts arbitrary text input passed via URL query parameter ('?q=').
Potential Impact: Potential entry point for SQL/NoSQL injection and Reflected XSS if user input is reflected without sanitization.
Recommended Mitigation: Implement parameterized database queries, sanitize inputs, and use context-aware HTML output encoding.

Observation: Login and user registration forms are exposed publicly without visible rate limiting or CAPTCHA on initial load.
Potential Impact: Susceptible to automated brute-force attacks, credential stuffing, and mass fake account registration.
Recommended Mitigation: Implement server-side rate limiting, account lockout policies, and adaptive CAPTCHA challenges.

Finding Title: Unrestricted File Upload on Photo Wall / Complaints
Observation: Visible file upload elements allow users to submit images and PDF documents.
Potential Impact: Risk of malicious file execution, path traversal, web shell deployment, or XML External Entity (XXE) injection.
Recommended Mitigation: Validate file MIME types by inspecting magic bytes, store files outside document root, and randomize filenames.
